label: B2 support options, the brute-contingency rival and their boundaries
paraphrase: Premise-free laws and finite models (logical boundaries, not metaphysical possibility). Laws: each of the two support bundles (local existence PSR for contingents with BX1 and BX2; contingents concrete with the grounding closure and the ground-to-esse-cause bridge) gives B2; the local existence PSR for all existents gives its contingent-only form; the brute-contingency rival excludes B2, the contingent existence PSR and each support bundle; under BX1 a being with an own-nature reason token (NECESSARY_EXISTENCE_BY_OWN_NATURE_4) at w is not contingent at w; for the own-nature model read through essence-esse identity, BX1 at w is exactly B6 at w; and in the ofModel arena embedding a being's existence fact is a brute contingent truth exactly when the being is contingent and its existence has no reason. Models over the existing first-mover frames at the reading world: (1) the brute first mover with no reasons: BX1 and BX2 hold, the existence PSR and B2 fail, and the rival holds with the First Way's mover as witness; (2) own-nature reasons: the existence PSR and BX2 hold, BX1 and B2 fail, the mover contingent with an own-nature token; (3) the moved thing as a non-causing occasion: the existence PSR and BX1 hold, BX2 and B2 fail; (4) a conserved mover with that occasion causing its esse: all three hold and B2 holds; (5) B2 without the existence PSR; (6) B2 without BX1; (7)-(9) one omission model for each premise of the grounding support; (10) its nonvacuity model.
